title: 内容创作词汇
markdown:
# 内容创作词汇

## 概述

本章提供内容生产全流程的英语词汇，分为创意与策划、拍摄与制作、文案与标题、发布与排期四个部分。它帮助读者用英语描述从选题到成片再到排期发布的完整过程，重点在创意、制作和发布动作的准确表达。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，适合团队沟通和创作文档。建议按制作流程的顺序学习，形成对内容生产链条的整体认识。

## 创意与策划

| 词汇                 | 词性 | 含义       | 常用搭配                                  |
| -------------------- | ---- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| concept              | n.   | 概念/创意  | creative concept, develop a concept       |
| narrative            | n.   | 叙事       | brand narrative, compelling narrative     |
| hook                 | n.   | 开头吸引点 | strong hook, attention hook               |
| CTA (Call to Action) | n.   | 行动号召   | add a CTA, clear CTA                      |
| storyboard           | n.   | 分镜       | create a storyboard, storyboard the video |
| niche                | n.   | 细分领域   | niche audience, find your niche           |

### 听说例句

> A: The video needs a stronger hook in the first second. B: Agreed. Let's open with a provocative question and add a clear CTA at the end.

> A: What's the creative concept for the new campaign? B: We're building a narrative around everyday moments. The storyboard focuses on three relatable scenarios.

### 写作表达

- A compelling narrative combined with a strong hook is essential for capturing audience attention within the first two seconds.
- Identifying a clearly defined niche allows creators to build a loyal and engaged community.

---

## 拍摄与制作

| 词汇         | 词性 | 含义      | 常用搭配                               |
| ------------ | ---- | --------- | -------------------------------------- |
| footage      | n.   | 素材/镜头 | raw footage, B-roll footage            |
| transition   | n.   | 转场      | smooth transition, creative transition |
| aspect ratio | n.   | 画面比例  | 9:16 aspect ratio, vertical format     |
| resolution   | n.   | 分辨率    | high resolution, 1080p resolution      |
| filter       | n.   | 滤镜      | apply a filter, popular filter         |
| voiceover    | n.   | 旁白      | add a voiceover, voiceover narration   |

### 听说例句

> A: Should we shoot in 4K or 1080p? B: 1080p is fine for TikTok. Just make sure the aspect ratio is 9:16 and the transitions are clean.

> A: Does this video need a voiceover? B: Yes, a voiceover with subtitles will make it more accessible. We have great B-roll footage to work with.

### 写作表达

- All content is produced in vertical 9:16 format with high-resolution footage optimized for mobile viewing.
- Creative transitions and strategic use of filters contribute to a visually cohesive brand aesthetic.

---

## 文案与标题

| 词汇          | 词性 | 含义      | 常用搭配                               |
| ------------- | ---- | --------- | -------------------------------------- |
| caption       | n.   | 文案/标题 | engaging caption, caption writing      |
| copywriting   | n.   | 文案写作  | marketing copywriting, persuasive copy |
| headline      | n.   | 标题      | catchy headline, headline optimization |
| tone of voice | n.   | 语调风格  | consistent tone, brand tone of voice   |
| tagline       | n.   | 标语      | brand tagline, memorable tagline       |
| hashtag       | n.   | 话题标签  | branded hashtag, trending hashtag      |

### 听说例句

> A: What tone of voice should we use for this campaign? B: Keep it casual and fun — match the platform. The caption should feel like a friend talking.

> A: Should we create a branded hashtag? B: Yes, something short and memorable. Pair it with a catchy tagline.

### 写作表达

- Effective copywriting adapts the brand tone of voice to resonate with each platform's unique audience.
- A well-crafted caption paired with a branded hashtag drives both discoverability and engagement.

---

## 发布与排期

| 词汇             | 词性  | 含义      | 常用搭配                                |
| ---------------- | ----- | --------- | --------------------------------------- |
| content calendar | n.    | 内容日历  | plan content calendar, weekly calendar  |
| post             | v./n. | 发布/帖子 | schedule a post, latest post            |
| schedule         | v.    | 排期      | schedule content, posting schedule      |
| frequency        | n.    | 频率      | posting frequency, optimal frequency    |
| peak hours       | n.    | 高峰时段  | post during peak hours, peak engagement |
| evergreen        | adj.  | 常青的    | evergreen content, always relevant      |

### 听说例句

> A: What's the optimal posting frequency for our account? B: Three to five times per week. We should schedule posts during peak hours — usually 7-9 PM.

> A: Should we only focus on trending content? B: Mix it up. Trending content drives reach, but evergreen content builds long-term value.

### 写作表达

- A well-structured content calendar ensures consistent posting frequency across all active platforms.
- Evergreen content continues to generate impressions and engagement long after the initial publication date.
